lens: boutique recruiter operational fit for evaluation-platform release semantics, workflow evidence requirements, typed review boundaries, and score honesty
strengths: Missing required human-workflow evidence is now attributed only to the workflow capability instead of contaminating decision, scenario, and trajectory. packages/evaluation/src/gates.ts:71-76 maps required evaluator bindings to capability names, packages/evaluation/src/gates.ts:115-147 applies missing evaluators per capability, packages/evaluation/src/evaluation.test.ts:519-549 locks the behavior with a unit test, and the current final artifact docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/opik-final-v2-r5/runs/evaluation_run_0f6a1ba9a24c2816323059669c23bab4/run-artifact.1191c6c3a3d5c401f74f269b62733d2e5b9c4270b504a64384706cd460c9bdc4.json:1 shows decision/scenario/trajectory at pass while workflow alone remains needs_review.

Overall P0 release readiness still stays needs_review when human workflow evidence is absent. evals/v2/suites/p0-release.v1.json:6-8 defines that suite purpose explicitly, docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/opik-integration-proof.json:142-149 records 12 deterministic-safety passes with 12 release-readiness needs_review results and reasonCode HUMAN_WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, and node scripts/evals/validate-evaluation-platform-proof.mjs currently returns releaseReadiness needs_review.

The 12 P0 scenarios do not fabricate human gold. evals/v2/README.md:37-40 and 57-69 state that imported annotations remain unreviewed proposals and that the initial bank truthfully remains unreviewed until explicit atomic adjudication exists; evals/v2/suites/p0-release.v1.json:8-78 lists P0 entries with adjudication set to unreviewed; representative scenario docs such as evals/v2/scenarios/ts-trj-005.r1.json:12-15 and 79-79 also remain unreviewed with empty criterionAdjudications; a read-only repository count confirmed p0_count 12, not_unreviewed [], and nonempty_criterionAdjudications [].

Deterministic safety, release readiness, and candidate-value ranking remain explicitly separate. docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/README.md:11-18 and 34-39 say deterministic safety passed while local gates stayed needs_review and that no candidate conversation or candidate scoring claim is present; docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/opik-integration-proof.json:10-15 excludes any claim that deterministic pass equals recruiter approval or release approval; evals/v2/README.md:12-14 and 81-84 say the cases score Talent Signal behavior and recruiter workflow, never a candidate, and that pass is not an aggregate score; evals/v2/review/reviewer-guide.v1.md:3 and 31-33 forbid candidate-worth judgments and prevent model review from owning P0 authority.

Typed boundary discipline is enforced across observation and remote-response contracts. apps/eval-runner/src/contracts.ts:46-62 requires reviewBoundary on every observation, apps/eval-runner/src/reviewBoundary.ts:28-35 and 50-167 type and validate evidence, confirmedState, interpretations, proposedActions, and observedOutcomes, and apps/eval-runner/src/builtinExecutors.ts:406-455 plus 553-596 build and require the same boundary for control-plane and model/integration paths.

The current repository checks pass on the frozen evidence set. pnpm eval:validate reports status pass with scenarioCount 36, p0Count 12, partitions p0 12 / dev 6 / held_out 8 / red_team 10, and contaminationFindingCount 0; pnpm --filter @talent-signal/evaluation test passes 22 of 22 tests including the missing-workflow-capability regression.
missing_evidence: There is still no named recruiter field study or atomic human-gold corpus proving that the workflow reduces real recruiter correction burden in production conditions. The important improvement is that the repository now preserves that absence honestly instead of translating engineering proof into business validation; see docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/README.md:34-39.
